gate_evidence: real `factory gate` run at this head in a throwaway --shared clone with refs/remotes/origin/main set to review_base; factory module loaded from that detached head via PYTHONPATH; only a [repo].slug line was prepended to .factory.toml for slug resolution, committed gate checks unmodified

findings.obligation: issue #79 Exit gate / schema-1: feedback items must use real provider IDs/links and the actual provider UTC update time when the provider supports it
findings.defect: Reviews are read via REST `GET /pulls/{n}/reviews`, and the item builder takes `updated=row.get('updated_at')`. The REST review object has no `updated_at` (it has `submitted_at`). Every review therefore gets `source_updated_at: null`, and any truncated review body raises `change_detection_incomplete` even though GraphQL exposes `PullRequestReview.updatedAt`.
evidence: factory/feedback.py: item(..., updated=row.get('updated_at'), ...) on review rows
GitHub REST Pull Request Review schema: submitted_at, not updated_at
findings.rationale: Criterion requires actual provider update time when supported. Corroboration (not oracle): commit 9127f40 switches reviews to GraphQL and reads `updatedAt`.

unnecessary_demand_rule: Any finding beyond D1 that does not cite a README/docs convention or an issue #79 acceptance criterion — wording nits on 'Legacy local gate', private `_lifecycle` import judgement, or gate-covered build/test/scan status.
